set.body: Build the missing middle stage from Plot[Row] to Scene. Add a small PlotCompiler API and inspectable intermediate types such as TrainedPlot/ResolvedLayer, initially supporting Geom.Point, Geom.Line, and Geom.Text. Acceptance: compiler resolves layer data, effective mappings, scaled/direct/constant AesValue values, params, and coordinates; includes regression tests for inherited mappings, plot-level scales shadowing layer direct mappings, empty/data-missing cases, and JVM+JS parity.
set.title: Graphics: add PlotCompiler spine and resolved plot IR
